nodes.label: Content as local typed TypeScript data
nodes.contributor: Uses lib/projects.ts instead of a CMS or MDX; a CMS adds hosting/auth/fetch for no benefit with 3 projects; typed module keeps content next to code, type-safe, trivially editable; a CMS could slot behind the same types if the portfolio grows.
nodes.norm_label: content as local typed typescript data

nodes.label: Animations built on motion
nodes.contributor: Uses the motion package (framer-motion successor, React 19 compatible) rather than hand-rolled CSS + IntersectionObserver; gives whileInView ergonomics, consistent easing via MotionConfig, built-in prefers-reduced-motion handling. Micro-interactions stay in plain CSS to avoid paying the runtime for trivial hovers.
